claim: The LSP spec site marks version 3.18 as the current specification version.

quote: method: textDocument/didChange params: DidChangeTextDocumentParams defined as follows:
claim: An open document's change is sent as the notification textDocument/didChange with params of type DidChangeTextDocumentParams.

quote: The version number points * to the version after all provided content changes have * been applied.
claim: DidChangeTextDocumentParams.textDocument is a VersionedTextDocumentIdentifier whose version is the version after all content changes in the notification are applied.
DidChangeTextDocumentParams carries contentChanges, an array of TextDocumentContentChangeEvent describing the actual content changes.
DidChangeTextDocumentParams.contentChanges is typed as an array of TextDocumentContentChangeEvent.
